column1: # teamsmith · command manifest — the language-neutral single source of the help surface.
# Read by scripts/lib/cmd-help.sh (the renderer), by tests/help-surface.sh (the surface's own checks)
# and by tests/routes.sh (Walk A's working set). One row per command the dispatcher accepts, plus the
# group table; the menu, the group pages and the command pages are all rendered from this file.
# Columns are tab-separated. `-` means "empty"; list fields are space separated.
#     name      the token the dispatcher accepts (a `case "$CMD" in` label of scripts/team)
#     group     the group id this command is listed under (level 1: `team help <group>`)
#     usage     one or more usage fragments, separated by ` ;; ` — every one is printed on the page
#     flags     the flags the usage fragments print (`-` = none); each needs an `cmd.<name>.arg.<flag>` prose key
#     subs      subcommands the usage fragments print
#     aliases   other labels the dispatcher accepts for this command (documented on this page)
#     terms     concept ids this page uses; the page repeats their definitions verbatim
#     faces     the faces this command touches, from the closed list: state docs config worktree skills meetings
#     effect    read-only | writes-<face> | starts-process   (the headline effect; `faces` carries the rest)
#     claims    extra declared facts `key=value` that prose may name (registry in tests/help-surface.sh)
#     probe     the probe recipe id that makes the declared effect happen in a scratch fixture
#     example   one example command line printed under `Example`
# The prose for every command lives in help.en.tsv (source) and help.zh.tsv (translation); a key the
# selected table lacks is printed with a marker naming it and falls back to the other table's value.
